evidence.role: Read-only transitive widget dependency for sidebar overlap mechanism
Read-only transitive widget dependency for sidebar overlap mechanism

finding.title: OctoSense floating Dock is excluded from neither maximal work area nor snapping work area
finding.certainty: Source geometry verified; screenshot/live active style not independently inspected.

source_points.fact: DesktopStyle::OctoSense has reserved_height0.0; comments165–166 explicitly describe overlay policy.
Macos/OctoSense shelf top is screen.height-88; shelf height78 at942, leaving10 bottom margin.
desk_rect records full rectangle before subtraction.
Draw layout subtracts StyleTween::reserved_height then gaps_out; passes area to layout.rects.
App::desk_area independently subtracts same reserved height from original desk_rect for interaction geometry.
Maximized window rect is exactly supplied area; snapped bounds also use area.

finding.geometry: For matching desk/shelf screen coordinates, maximized outer bottom=H-reserved_height-gaps_out, Dock top=H-88. With reserved0 and gaps_out<88, those rectangles overlap vertically. Reserving88 gives bottom=H-88-gaps_out, preserving an existing gap above Dock.
finding.distinction: This is the OctoSense internal shelf, not a verified diagnosis of the macOS system Dock. Active screenshot style must be confirmed by Root; Macos style also has reserved0 but is not automatically in the requested change scope.

minimal_recommendation.change_proposed: For the affected DesktopStyle::OctoSense row, reserve88.0 logical pixels, equal to current shelf height78 plus bottom offset10. Update comments and the existing reserved array expectation at301 accordingly.
minimal_recommendation.why_minimal: Both render and interaction/snap paths already read StyleTween::reserved_height, so changing the central style value keeps them consistent without duplicate arithmetic or Muse-specific host branches.
keep_unchanged: Muse composer height or arbitrary bottom spacer
minimal_recommendation.scope_impact: This intentionally changes OctoSense work-area policy for every app in that style, affecting maximize/snap and initial/clamped free-window sizing. Freely positioned windows may still extend behind Dock because fit preserves only a reachable title bar. It is not a promise of full containment for all floating windows.
minimal_recommendation.if_policy_must_remain_overlay: If overlay for ordinary windows must be preserved, a maximize/snap-only workarea design is possible but is a larger change requiring the same geometry in both desk draw and desk_area consumers; do not patch only one caller.
minimal_recommendation.not_a_magic_constant: 88 derives from this frozen shelf implementation; if Dock geometry later changes, keep reservation and geometry coupled. Do not double-subtract reserved height in downstream layout.

sidebar_observation.scope: Only transitive widget geometry inspected, not current Muse sidebar code or screenshot.
sidebar_observation.mechanism: ScrollBars::begin begins content with layout.with_scroll; draw_scroll_bars later uses the same turtle rect. ScrollBar vertical track draws inside the far-right bar_size strip; default bar_size10.0. A content row's rightmost action can overlap that strip unless it leaves a gutter.
sidebar_observation.minimal_direction: In Muse's history row/content container, reserve right-side gutter for the actual scrollbar width plus small spacing, keeping delete target before it. Prefer this local layout correction to changing global scrollbar width/behavior. Do not infer the live themed width is exactly10 without checking it.
sidebar_observation.test_scope: Root can reuse current UI verification with a genuinely overflowing history list, narrow/wide sidebar, delete click versus scrollbar drag. This reviewer ran none and does not assert overlap fixed.

existing_test_entries.purpose: Existing style table/reserved-height/tween assertions; OctoSense reserved expected value needs deliberate update if policy changes.
Existing shelf placement remains unchanged; Dock must stay at H-88 with height78.
Maximize uses supplied work area and preserves restore rect; extend assertion with Dock-safe area.
Snap follows resized work area without destroying restore geometry.
Existing free-window reachability remains intentional; do not silently replace it with full containment.
Hit/snap calculation uses same reduced area.

command_basis: Package octosense-shell verified in crates/shell/Cargo.toml and root workspace membership; commands shown for SDK root. Build environment/dependencies were not tested.
recommended_narrow_addition: At existing desktop style/layout test seam, assert maximized and bottom-snap outer bottom <= Dock top with selected OctoSense style, both settled and during relevant style transition; keep restore rect. Existing tests mostly verify supplied area or old constants, not the cross-layer non-overlap invariant.
limits: No SDK/app/Host edits, no builds/tests, no model/semantic rerun, no GUI/screenshots or running-port interaction (8493/8484 untouched).
No user data, account/profile, or secret reads. Only this independent owned report pair written.
Root remains the sole implementation owner; source analysis supports the proposed geometry correction but does not constitute visual acceptance.
